name: Pro Music & Sound Studio 4.0 (سٹوڈیو ماسٹر) — 8 Iconic Instruments, Dhol, Tabla & Settings Menu
features: Pro Studio DAW Redesign: Sleek modern studio interface with glowing engine status, 8-card Instrument Deck with 1-click selection, and collapsible Effects Rack

8 Iconic Studio Instruments: Indian Harmonium, Real Bansuri Flute, Modern Concert Violin, Acoustic Guitar, Concert Grand Piano & Rhodes, Classical Indian Sitar, Kashmiri Santoor, Studio Jazz Saxophone
Concert Grand Piano & Rhodes: Felt hammer knock (<3ms), trichord unisons with sub-cent micro-detuning (+0.8/-0.8 cents), soundboard resonance, multi-harmonic decay, and Rhodes tine ring
Classical Indian Sitar: Dynamic Jawari bridge buzz filter envelope (2.4-3.8 kHz), steel mizrab click, and taraf sympathetic string shimmer
Kashmiri Santoor: 4-string course acoustic shimmer with natural micro-beating, walnut mezrab mallets tap, and long crystalline sustain
Studio Jazz Saxophone: Cane reed vibration, conical brass bore formants, breath turbulence noise, and 5.4 Hz delayed vibrato
Dedicated Accessible Settings Menu Modal (F4 / Alt+O): Tabbed navigation for Audio Engine, Screen Reader / Accessibility, Keyboard mappings, and Studio Themes
Authentic Punjabi Wedding Dhol & Classical Tabla: Dagga bass, Tilli cane snap, 16 Classical Tabla Bols, and 12 celebration auto-rhythms
Collapsible Studio Master Effects Rack: Reverb, Ping-Pong Delay, 3-Band Parametric EQ, Tube Warmth & Limiter
Full NVDA & JAWS Accessibility: 100% offline, zero key collisions, live ARIA announcements, and complete keyboard shortcuts
